item.title: A new way to think about borrow checking (in reverse)
item.description:
📝 This isn't going to be your normal shared-xor-mutable borrow checking. This is another forward pass, which figures out where each reference points to. That means that buff is invalidated above the line where it's used, which is a use-after-free.
🔗 Read more: https://verdagon.dev/blog/reverse-borrow-checking
